description: A Java class implementing a colored triangle list renderer using OpenGL ES 2.0, including shader compilation, buffer management, and drawing routines.

classes.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList
classes.description: Handles rendering of multiple triangles with a solid color using OpenGL ES 2.0.

methods.name: Gles2ColoredTriangleList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the triangle list with provided vertex coordinates and color.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Draws the triangle list using the provided MVP matrix.

methods.name: checkGlError
methods.description: Utility method to check for OpenGL errors after calls.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Internal class that encapsulates the OpenGL shaders and program used for rendering triangles.

methods.name: Program
methods.description: Initializes and links the vertex and fragment shaders into a program.

methods.name: use
methods.description: Sets this shader program as current in OpenGL.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds the MVP matrix, vertex buffer, and color uniform to prepare for drawing.
